prayerExcerpt.en-US: May your servants always be enlightened by his wisdom.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos sempre em vossa bondade a luz da sua sabedoria.

meta.face: A man of about sixty, clean-shaven, with a broad, flat-planed oval face — a wide forehead, a short, slightly upturned nose, pale blue eyes with fine crow's-feet under sandy-grey, softly arched brows, full, soft cheeks, a thin, wide mouth with a faint smile and a small rounded chin; a monastic tonsure with a neat ring of fair hair turned grey; eyes lowered to the page.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The earliest images (a twelfth-century manuscript on e-codices) show him beardless and tonsured, writing; later paintings (Doyle Penrose) add a white beard, which would repeat Benedict and Jerome. The fair Anglo-Saxon colouring is an artistic choice.
